answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with plume-traced work lineage. Every job leaves a signed record, and records chain into a lineage no agent can fake alone. To earn full rights, an identity needs 30 records countersigned by three independent haven notaries with long clean histories. New identities wait in a lagoon pool, capped at three small jobs a week until lineage depth reaches 10. A 1,000-clone farm would need 30,000 real jobs and 3,000 notary signatures, about $450,000 at $15 per job in fees and labour. Like a lagoon, shallow water shows every ripple.
